request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "The interaction of hours momentum and pay momentum failed.", "3": "Their joint signal showed slightly negative, insignificant predictive power.", "4": "The flow rates V02 and V03 were the most informative.", "5": "When V02 rose faster than V03 over three months, groups significantly underperformed, mostly in low-T periods.", "6": "Reversing the direction at six months gave a modest positive signal, with t near two.", "7": "It was consistent across T regimes and overlapped little with base factors.", "8": "This reversal was chosen after seeing the earlier result, so treat it cautiously.", "9": "Contrasting pay growth with the stock rate's deviation from its long norm was weak.", "10": "It covered only half the sample and flipped sign when T was high."}, "hypothesis": "Flow composition, not flow levels, carries the earlier signal: groups whose V03-to-V02 ratio rose most in log terms over three months earn higher next-month relative returns, without conditioning on T regimes.", "expression": "csrank(lchg(ratio(V03,V02),3))"}
